storyCards.headline: Pictures Of Matchstick Men: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
The Status Quo's "Pictures Of Matchstick Men" reached #12 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Pictures of Matchstick Men" is the first hit single by British rock band the Status Quo.

The song peaked at #12 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Pictures Of Matchstick Men was released in 1968.

"Pictures Of Matchstick Men" by The Status Quo.

Chart story — peaked at #12 on the Hot 100.
